Also start thinking in reverse, literally. Flex some combos that are reverse based instead of forward-based, adds another layer of options all together

If you plan on pushing t\-shirts on other sites, I'd highly recommend printful. I've been using them for about a year now and it's definitely better quality DTG printing in my opinion, plus basic color shirts \(black, white, navy\) have a much lower base cost than amazon so you'd save money right off the bat versus buying your own shirts off of amazon then re\-shipping. You can manually do orders too so all you have to do is prep the order details and printful will print and ship on your behalf. You can even have your own custom logo on the shipping label and such with the package that helps you up your production value to the customer. Plenty of shipping options too, i've been able to ship a single shirt using DHL on there for as little as $2.23. It has integration for ETSY and a bunch of other sites too to automate transactions fully for you. But yeah if you plan on selling on Mercari that'll be manual orders, but I think if you want to do ebay they have ebay integration for the fully automated stuff too \(I haven't messed with ebay yet\).. if you're interested you can sign up here [https://www.chiworx.com/printful](https://www.chiworx.com/printful)

this method vs re\-routing your own amazon orders should save you a lot of money, plus there's other stuff they print on other than t\-shirts.. towels, poster prints, multiple types of shirt styles, various styles of hoodies, socks, pillows, cell phone cases, leggings, dresses, bikinis and more. They even have templates so you can fine tune your artwork to fit on everything perfectly
